harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 13 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (standbys) on RHEL9. Demonstrated full failover: stopped node1, promoted node2 to writable primary with zero data loss, repointed node3 to node2, and rejoined the recovered former primary (node1) as a standby of node2 via fresh pg_basebackup. Then executed the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol on all three nodes (standbys first, primary last), verifying changed boot_id and full replication/quorum recovery after each restart, finishing with an end-to-end write propagated to all nodes.
actions_performed: Installed postgresql-server 13.23 on node1, node2, node3 via dnf
Initialized primary DB on node1; configured wal_level=replica, max_wal_senders, hot_standby, listen_addresses='*'
Fixed password_encryption mismatch (md5 default vs scram-sha-256 in pg_hba.conf) that was blocking replicator authentication
Created replicator role and appdb database with a bench table and seed rows on node1
Opened firewalld port 5432/tcp on all three nodes
Built pg_basebackup-based standbys on node2 and node3 from node1, verified streaming replication and data propagation
Simulated primary loss (stopped postgresql on node1), promoted node2 via pg_promote(), verified no committed data lost and node2 writable
Repointed node3's primary_conninfo to node2 and confirmed streaming resumed with full data set
Rejoined node1 as a standby of node2 via fresh pg_basebackup, confirmed streaming and data integrity
Captured pre-restart boot_id, service state, and data counts on node1, node3, node2 (in that order)
Rebooted node1, node3, node2 one at a time (background nohup reboot with ack before disconnect), polled until reachable
Verified changed boot_id on all three nodes post-restart, and confirmed replication/quorum and data fully recovered after each restart before moving to the next node
Performed final end-to-end write on node2 (primary) and confirmed propagation to node1 and node3 (7/7 rows matching)

evidence.requirement: Primary/standby replication established (node1 primary, node2/node3 standby)
evidence.summary: node1 initialized as primary with wal_level/replica settings and replicator role; node2 and node3 built via pg_basebackup with -R and started as standbys (pg_is_in_recovery=t).

evidence.requirement: Replication actively streaming and data propagating from primary to both standbys
evidence.summary: pg_stat_replication on node1 shows both walreceivers streaming; a new row inserted on node1 appears on node2 and node3.

evidence.requirement: Failover: standby takes over as writable primary without losing committed data
evidence.summary: Marker row committed and confirmed replicated to both standbys before node1 was stopped; node2 promoted via pg_promote() and confirmed writable with all 4 pre-failover rows intact plus a new post-failover write.

evidence.requirement: Surviving standby (node3) repointed to new primary (node2)
evidence.summary: node3's primary_conninfo updated to node2 and restarted; node2 shows node3's walreceiver streaming; node3 has full post-failover dataset.

evidence.requirement: Recovered former primary (node1) rejoins as standby of the current primary (node2)
evidence.summary: node1 rebuilt via pg_basebackup from node2, started in recovery mode with all data intact; node2 shows both node1 and node3 streaming; a new write on node2 propagates to both.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 6bb7e004... captured with active standby and 6 rows; reboot acked before disconnect; post-restart boot_id 12244391... (changed); postgresql active, standby recovered, data intact, node2 shows node1 streaming again.

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id fbdf5b2c... captured with active standby and 6 rows; reboot acked before disconnect; post-restart boot_id 318b155b... (changed); postgresql active, standby recovered, data intact, node2 shows both standbys streaming.

evidence.requirement: node2 (primary) restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state with quorum
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bf4e9cbb... captured as active primary with 6 rows; reboot acked before disconnect; post-restart boot_id cf4a8c23... (changed); postgresql active as primary again, both node1 and node3 walreceivers streaming.

evidence.requirement: Post-restart end-to-end data integrity across full cluster
evidence.summary: New row inserted on node2 (primary) after all three restarts; node1 and node3 both report matching row count of 7, confirming replication fully healthy end-to-end.
